author: Espinosa & Ortea, 2000

note.en: A small glossy marginella shell about 1.9 cm long that lives on sand and rubble and is rarely noticed by divers. Known here from 7 museum specimen records (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2003).
note.es: Una concha marginela pequeña y brillante de unos 1.9 cm que vive en arena y escombro coralino y rara vez la notan los buzos. Conocido aquí por 7 registros de ejemplares de museo (Gandoca-Manzanillo refugio, Manzanillo, 2000 a 2003).

evidence: GBIF: 7 specimen records in the region (Gandoca-Manzanillo refuge, Manzanillo, 2000 to 2003)

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records (museum specimens), Gandoca to Limón
